title: Welcome to RoundForge Competitive Programming
description:
**A Codeforces community bot for every server**

`/handle link` → `/handle verify` — prove account ownership
`/handle show` — Discord ~ Codeforces avatar card and profile
`/problem` — unsolved problem by rating and topic
`/daily show` → `/daily claim` — daily challenge, 10 points
`/leaderboard` — server ratings or monthly daily points
`/contests` — upcoming rounds in your server timezone
`/rank sync` — refresh your rating and CF role
`/handle unlink` — remove your link

`/training start` → `/training next` — beginner tracks
`/upsolve start` → `/upsolve check` — post-contest goals
`/blitz menu` → select players → choose settings → **Accept & ready** — multiplayer races
`/blitz host` — manage a game for mentioned players; optional manager
Select multiple topics, set time, and toggle everyone-finishes and standings in the menu.
A visible 10-second countdown comes before the problem and voice effects.
`/blitz standings` — verified solve times and ranks
Omit blitz minutes for unlimited time; `/blitz cancel` stops the game.
`/blitz games` — simultaneous games; `/blitz cancel` releases voices

`/tournament create` — organizer: signup buttons, 2–32 players, automatic brackets
`/tournament list` / `bracket` — view events; `retry` / `resolve` — manager decisions
Each tournament duel has Accept buttons and the Blitz countdown.

`/activity` — open the shared tournament Activity in your current voice room (operator setup required)

Organizers can use `/blitz solo` to test voice controls without another account.
Organizers: `/admin configure`, `/admin channel`, `/admin setup_roles`, `/admin refresh`, `/admin status`.
Daily points reward participation; previously solved problems may be solved again. Account verification does not certify real-world identity or organizational affiliation.
